cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the whole globe changed by +0.030 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.014 to +0.046), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.074 mm/day.

cautions: Only 26% of this region's area has land cells with data in at least 95% of the months, so the result describes only that part.
ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the whole globe changed by +0.057 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.033 to +0.082), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.141 mm/day.
